profile.name: Abdel Ali
profile.bio: Full-stack engineer from Rabat, Morocco. I build open-source developer tools and I'm the creator of OSSRadar, AgentGuard and DevKit.

about.text: I'm a full-stack developer with 5+ years of experience shipping web applications and developer tools. I believe in building in public: everything I create is MIT-licensed, contributor-friendly and designed to help other developers.

highlights.title: 5+ years
highlights.text: Full stack experience (TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python)

highlights.title: Open source
highlights.text: I build tools that make life easier for developers, from issue discovery to AI agent security

highlights.title: Community first
highlights.text: My projects have contributor-driven roadmaps, good-first-issues and welcoming CONTRIBUTING guides

projects.name: OSSRadar
projects.description: Discover GitHub projects you can actually contribute to. Scans good-first-issue and help-wanted issues in real time, filterable by language.

projects.name: AgentGuard
projects.description: Security, monitoring, auditing and replay for AI coding agents (Claude, etc.). Protect your pipelines from agent hallucinations and mistakes.

projects.name: DevKit
projects.description: Open-source developer toolbox with 17 free, privacy-first tools. Everything runs 100% in the browser, no data leaves your machine.

projects.name: github-academy
projects.description: Practice-first GitHub learning simulator. 56 lessons and 20 missions that teach GitHub by doing, not by watching.

projects.name: AlgoAtlas
projects.description: Community-driven atlas of algorithms. Explore, visualize and understand algorithms through interactive examples.

projects.name: ComponentGallery
projects.description: A gallery of small HTML/CSS components built by the community. Beauty, simplicity and zero dependencies.

experience.title: Building in public · Open source developer tools
experience.text: Creating and maintaining open source projects: OSSRadar (issue discovery), AgentGuard (AI agent security), DevKit (developer toolbox).

experience.title: Software Engineer · Full stack
experience.text: 5+ years delivering web applications end-to-end: frontend with React/Next.js, backend with Node.js and Python, deploying on AWS and Vercel.

contact.text: Open to open-source collaboration, contributor questions and interesting projects. Reach out — I usually reply fast.
